epic-spec-workflow.label: Specification

stages.label: First principles
stages.purpose: Approve the intended outcome and constraints.

stages.label: Context and reconciliation
stages.purpose: Reconcile current evidence with the approved basis.

stages.label: Research
stages.purpose: Resolve factual gaps or route the remaining uncertainty.

stages.label: Design decisions
stages.purpose: Resolve the material human decisions.

stages.label: Semantic design
stages.purpose: Prepare the proposed behavior and constraints.

stages.label: Adversarial review
stages.purpose: Resolve findings or return to the affected stage.

stages.label: Visuals and design proposal
stages.purpose: Publish and verify the supervisor design proposal.

stages.label: Supervisor review
stages.purpose: Review the exact design and visuals together.

stages.label: Release and handoff
stages.purpose: Verify the immutable semantic release and handoff.

epic-spec-workflow.completion: Specification scope is complete. Implementation planning is a separately invoked workflow.

implementation-program-workflow.label: Implementation program

stages.label: First principles
stages.purpose: Verify inherited intent or approve the program basis.

stages.label: Program design
stages.purpose: Prepare milestones, ownership, and dependency contracts.

stages.label: Design proposal
stages.purpose: Publish and verify the supervisor proposal.

stages.label: Supervisor review
stages.purpose: Review the exact program and proposal.

stages.label: Project resources
stages.purpose: Upload every planning artifact and verify project-member access before issue creation.

stages.label: Issue creation
stages.purpose: Create all approved issues without team assignees.

stages.label: Individual issue HITL
stages.purpose: Complete every created issue’s own decisions and supervisor review before assignment.

stages.label: Team assignment
stages.purpose: Assign the fully reviewed issue set to the three approved workstreams.

stages.label: Ticket delivery
stages.purpose: Receive the verified program completion event.

stages.label: Program reconciliation
stages.purpose: Verify integrated delivery against the approved program.

implementation-program-workflow.completion: Program delivery and reconciliation are complete for this process.

implementation-ticket-workflow.label: Ticket implementation

stages.label: First principles
stages.purpose: Verify inherited intent or approve the ticket basis.

stages.label: Ticket design
stages.purpose: Prepare the bounded implementation design.

stages.label: Issue HITL decisions
stages.purpose: Resolve and assess this issue’s open-ended human decisions.

stages.label: Design proposal
stages.purpose: Publish and verify the supervisor proposal.

stages.label: Supervisor review
stages.purpose: Review the exact ticket design and proposal.

stages.label: Review handoff
stages.purpose: Return the approved review or verify its reuse for assigned execution.

stages.label: Implementation
stages.purpose: Implement and verify the single pull request.

stages.label: Merge confirmation
stages.purpose: Receive the verified merge event.

stages.label: As-built reconciliation
stages.purpose: Verify the implemented behavior against its approved design.

stages.label: Cleanup and completion
stages.purpose: Finish provenance-scoped cleanup and reconciliation.

implementation-ticket-workflow.completion: Ticket implementation and reconciliation are complete for this process.

decision-workflow.label: Design decisions
decision-workflow.processName: Sequential decisions with integrated Ground Me

stages.label: Select the next question
stages.purpose: Select the next unresolved material question.

stages.label: Human decision
stages.purpose: Record an explicit answer or investigate its premise.

stages.label: Assess the decision
stages.purpose: Analyze the answer and surface material concerns with a suggested change.

stages.label: Ground Me
stages.purpose: Verify the explanation and any explicit combined answer.

stages.label: Record and recompute
stages.purpose: Record the answer and recompute the affected frontier.

decision-workflow.completion: The decision subprocess is complete. Its parent workflow determines the next stage.

ground-me-workflow.label: Ground Me

stages.label: Gather evidence
stages.purpose: Reconstruct the implementation and its decision lineage.

stages.label: Review provenance
stages.purpose: Check the explanation against its sources.

stages.label: Visual explanation
stages.purpose: Prepare the evidenced explanation.

stages.label: Understanding alignment
stages.purpose: Confirm, correct, deepen, or explicitly answer with alignment.

stages.label: Return to the decision
stages.purpose: Return validated evidence and the human response to the parent.

ground-me-workflow.completion: Grounding is complete. The parent decision workflow determines the next action.

multimodal-research-workflow.label: Research

stages.label: Gather research
stages.purpose: Gather applicable evidence for the factual questions.

stages.label: Evaluate evidence
stages.purpose: Continue research, request a decision, revise intent, or proceed.

multimodal-research-workflow.completion: The research subprocess is complete. Its parent consumes the reported outcome.

adversarial-review-workflow.label: Adversarial review

stages.label: Review the design
stages.purpose: Identify material findings against the current source.

stages.label: Human disposition
stages.purpose: Resolve findings that require human judgment.

stages.label: Record the outcome
stages.purpose: Return the review outcome to its owning workflow.

adversarial-review-workflow.completion: The review subprocess is complete. Its parent routes the reported disposition.
